flags.why: The word xoáy for a hair whorl is used nationwide, including in Northern Vietnamese.
flags.fix: Remove the Central and Southern tags.

flags.why: The entry omits the common verb meaning 'to brake'.
flags.fix: Add: verb [Northern] | to brake; ex: Tài xế phanh gấp. = The driver braked suddenly.

flags.why: Nhiệt in this example is the noun 'heat', not the compound element meaning 'thermal'.
flags.fix: Nhà máy nhiệt điện này sử dụng than. = This thermal power plant uses coal.

flags.why: The entry omits the common noun meaning 'outward appearance'.
flags.fix: Add: noun | outward appearance; ex: Đừng chỉ đánh giá qua hình thức bên ngoài. = Don't judge solely by outward appearance.

flags.why: Bào chữa commonly means making excuses for someone's actions outside a courtroom.
flags.fix: Add: verb | to make excuses for; to justify; ex: Đừng bào chữa cho hành động của anh ấy. = Don't make excuses for his actions.
